content: Yoosefi Amuho Bilethaa
Guutha wodepe guye, Gibxe kawa ushsha kaapoynne katha kaapoy banta godaa, Gibxe kawa naaqidosona.
Kawoy he nam7u kaapota bolla daro yilotidi,
Yoosefi qashetida, qasho keetha naageysata kaapuwa son enta qachis.
Naageyseta halaqay enta Yoosefas sheedhis, ika entaw kiitetees. Enti qasho keethan daro wode uttidosona.
Gibxe kawa ushsha kaapoynne katha kaapoy, qasho keethan de7ishe nam7ayka issi qamma dumma dumma amuho amuhidosona. He amuhotas dumma dumma birshethay de7ees.
Yoosefi wonta entako geliya wode enti azzanidi uttidashin be7is.
I entana, “Hachi hinte som7oy ayis dhumidee?” yaagidi oychis.
Enti, “Nu nam7ayka amuho amuhida, shin nuus birshiya asi dhayis” yaagidosona. Yoosefi entako, “Amuho birshiya eratethay Xoossaba gidenneyee? Ane hinte amuhuwa taw odite” yaagis.
Yaatin ushsha kaapoy ba amuhuwa Yoosefas odis; “Taani ta amuhon issi woyne ta sinthan be7as.
He woyniyas heedzu tasheti de7oosona. I hayxidi, ciiyi simmidi teeris.
Kawo wanci ta kushen de7ees. Taani woyne teera ekada iyan gum7ada, he wanca kawa kushen wothas” yaagis.
Yoosefi, “Ha amuhuwa birshethay haysa; heedzu tasheti heedzu gallasata.
Heedzu gallasata giddon Kawoy nena qashope billana. I nena kase shuumatethaako zaarana. Kase neeni ushsha kaapo gidada ootheysada neeni kawa wanca iya kushiyan wothana.
Shin new sa7i lo77ida wode tana dogopa; taw keeha. Tabaa kawas odada, ha qasho keethafe tana kesisa.
Tana Ibraawe biittafe wolqan ehidosona. Hari attoshin, haysan tana qashos gathiyaba aybibaaka oothabike” yaagis.
Kathaa kaapoy Yoosefi amuhuwa loythidi birshidaysa be7ida wode Yoosefako, “Taani amuhida amuhoy haysa; ta huuphen heedzu gabate uythi de7ees;
bolla bagga gabatiyan Gibxe kawas dumma dumma katha qommofe uuketida uythay de7ees. Shin kafoti he ta huuphen de7iya gabatiyape moosona” yaagis.
Yoosefi, “He amuhuwa birshethay haysa; heedzu gabateti heedzu gallasata.
Heedzu gallasa giddon Kawoy nena qashope billana. Ne qoodhiya qanxisidi mithan kaqisana; ne ashuwaka kafoy maana” yaagis.
Heedzantho gallasan Gibxe Kawoy ba yeletida gallasan ba moorinnata ubbaas gibira giigisis. Ushsha kaapuwanne katha kaapuwa billi ehidi ba asa sinthan essis.
Ushsha kaapuwa iya shuumatethaako zaarin, I kawa kushiyan wanca wothis.
Shin Kawoy kathaa kaapuwa kaqisis. Ubbayka Yoosefi enta amuhuwa birshidaysada hanis.
Shin ushsha kaapoy Yoosefa hassayonna dogi aggis.
